rounds: Trace the complete contract and browser boundary: dedicated unchecked network scope, closed filters, bounded copied metadata, no capture command capability; test legacy-scope denial and stale-result suppression.
Check read-only and resource behavior: storage and timer invariance, stopped/live capture, restore failure and UTF-8 result bounds. Reuse cached entry sizes and one native transport runner.
Review UI and consumers: persistent MCP sidebar, separate tabs preserving capture/approval, responsive layout, exact package/server hashes, current documentation and native blocker/GM regressions.
